title: Go command whose go.mod requires four modules and whose binary contains two

source.exclude_note: bin/ is the build output; the source stage is the checkout without it

artefact.note: a static Go binary; the toolchain records the modules it linked inside it

shipped.note: primary component; a development build has no version of its own, so any version is accepted
imported by main.go; linked. An old version with known advisories, chosen so that the security view has something real to find
the Go standard library, compiled into every Go binary at the version of the toolchain that built it (GO_VERSION in tools/versions.env; update this line when that changes)

not_shipped.note: imported only by main_test.go; go.mod has to require it, the binary never contains it
imported only by debug.go, which is compiled only with -tags debug; the release build leaves it out
required by golang.org/x/text's own go.mod; no package of it is imported, so it is in the module graph and nowhere else
a test dependency of gopkg.in/yaml.v3; in the module graph only
